summary: Huntingdon County, PA steel observation tower on Butler Knob, built 1922-23; staffed into the 1970s and now closed, with a weather station on the summit.

access.note: Wikipedia describes the firetower on the summit as closed; the summit is reached by a rough road

visit.trail_note: Rough road to the summit; views from a nearby scree slope. The tower is closed, so do not climb it.

events.note: Completed spring 1923; construction began in 1922 per 1922 and 1926 reports

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1926 report says the tower was erected during 1922, and a September 1922 paper calls it under construction. An April 1923 paper says it is about completed, and a 1972 article gives spring 1923 as the construction date. We date the finished tower to 1923 and note the 1922 start.

notes_for_editor: Built year 1923 in the record matches the completion reports; no correction. Height 18.3 m matches the 60-foot figure, which may be overall height rather than height to the cab floor. Record elevation 708 m (about 2,323 ft) differs from the 2,360 ft given in the 1922 and 1926 reports (about 719 m); not changed, for an editor to check. Wikipedia is undated, so the closed status and weather station rest on it alone. Record status standing is consistent with the 1972 article and Wikipedia, but no dated 2025-26 source was found. No entry for this tower in the cached NHLR or FFLOS pages.
